description: A host listed in the result of regenerating all nginx configs

name.description: First domain name, or the incoming port of a stream

error.description: Why nginx rejected the host (offline) or why it could not be regenerated (failed)

message.description: Warnings: the custom locations that are disabled or don't resolve right now, one per line. Skipped: why the host was left alone
message.example: /api: Disabled because nginx rejected it: unknown directive "proxy_passs"

details.description: Offline: the host's meta.nginx_details. Failed: the structured details of the error, if any. For clients that word the error themselves

locations.description: Warnings: the custom locations of `message`, with the code and params the UI words them from (see meta.nginx_locations)
